To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed and developed an innovative semantic reasoning framework to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environments.

(i) the use of the μConcept Knowledge Representation Language and of the corresponding μConcept Rule Language, based on RDF(S) and RIF, allows the specification of a semantic reasoning framework that is able to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environment, (ii) this framework is able to take decisions based on context information, and (iii) the use of this semantic reasoning framework allows the dynamic visualization of context information.

the proposed approach allows us to: (i) supervise and manage the pervasive computing environment, (ii) take an adequate decision based on the reasoning of context events handled by different actors, and (iii) visualize the dynamic context information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an intelligent framework for the supervision and management of the pervasive computing environment.
the use of semantic reasoning to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environments.
the development of a semantic reasoning framework to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed framework, based on the μConcepts, allows to supervise and manage pervasive computing environments in a more intelligent way, by using semantic technology to integrate information coming form heterogeneous sources, to share it easily and to reason upon it.
the proposed framework is a good candidate to be used as a general purpose context awareness framework in the future.

, in the context of the SEMbySEM project, we have shown that a semantic reasoning framework based on μConcepts can provide the necessary support for a pervasive computing system in order to supervise and manage contexts and objects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed semantic framework is able to manage and monitor the environment, and to take decisions in real-time based on the information provided by the sensors and actuators.

the use of a semantic language to represent the knowledge about contexts, objects and actors, and the use of semantic rules for reasoning and acting upon them, is a promising approach for the supervision and the management of pervasive computing environments.
the proposed framework allows us to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environments by taking advantages of the semantic technologies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to use the μC-KRL language for reasoning and acting upon context sources, and for their dynamic visualization.
it shows how semantic reasoning can be used in the pervasive context to manage the environment and the actors in it.
the proposed framework is a promising approach to manage pervasive environments.
